guard: mutation-coverage and mutation-reproof refuse live-shaped commands before executing them, including unsuffixed broker-starting suites
why: A suffix-only live guard closes today's :live configs and leaves every broker-starting suite that never used that suffix reachable from a coverage audit or a changed-source reproof.
Each mutation removes one half of the execution-boundary refusal so the cell that would have gone silently missing is the one that reddens.

mutations.name: coverage executes a live-shaped command instead of refusing it
mutations.expectRed: coverage does not execute a live-shaped command
mutations.cell: coverage does not execute a live-shaped command

mutations.name: live-named tokens are no longer refused by the shared predicate
mutations.expectRed: a live-named command is refused without executing
mutations.cell: a live-named command is refused without executing

mutations.name: infrastructure markers in suite source are ignored
mutations.expectRed: an unsuffixed broker-starting suite is refused without executing
mutations.cell: an unsuffixed broker-starting suite is refused without executing

mutations.name: node options before a suite path skip source inspection
mutations.expectRed: a node option before a marked suite path is refused
mutations.cell: a node option before a marked suite path is refused

mutations.name: reproof proves live-shaped fixtures instead of refusing them
mutations.expectRed: reproof names a refused live-shaped fixture and does not execute it
mutations.cell: reproof names a refused live-shaped fixture and does not execute it
